explanation: The statement is about `RS.tensorPow` (defined at `RS/Definitions.lean:2406` as `X ^⊗ n` with the unit at `n = 0`), a library-local definition that does not exist in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core (grep for `tensorPow`/`tensorPower` in Mathlib only finds unrelated `tensorPower` of tensors in `LinearAlgebra/TensorAlgebra/ToTensorPower.lean`). The proof also relies on the file-private `id_zero_transfer` and on preadditive monoidal lemmas (`MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight`, `Limits.IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero`), but the mathematical content — a self-dual line object `U` with `U ⊗ U ≅ 𝟙_ A` over a nonzero unit has all tensor powers with nonzero identity — is not present as a Mathlib declaration. Searches for `IsZero` lemmas in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal` and for `IsZero` interacting with `⊗` returned only unrelated results (`Monoidal/Grp.lean`, `Monoidal/Cartesian/Mon.lean`, `Monoidal/Tor.lean`), so no single Mathlib declaration gives this either as a duplicate or as a one-line special case.
